ValidationRule.description: 當評估結果為「待觀察」或「未通過」時，必須填寫「改善計劃」。
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( OR ( TEXT(Evaluation_Result__c)='Under Observation', TEXT(Evaluation_Result__c)='Failed' ), ISBLANK(Improvement_Plan__c)=TRUE )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: When Evaluation Result is "Under Observation" or "Failed", "Improvement Plan" must be provided.
